```{python}
#| output: false
import os
import re

import pandas as pd
import yaml

cfg = yaml.safe_load(open("configs/settings.yaml"))

COUNTY_MAP = cfg["county_map"]
ID_TO_COUNTY = {v: k for k, v in COUNTY_MAP.items()}
COUNTY_IDS = list(cfg["county_ids"])
N_COUNTIES = len(COUNTY_IDS)


def clean_ofm(cfg, file_path, ofm_type="total_pop"):
    """Parse OFM postcensal population estimates, preferring decennial counts.

    When the workbook includes both a postcensal estimate and a census count for
    the same year, the census count column is retained.
    """
    if ofm_type != "total_pop":
        raise ValueError("This dashboard only supports OFM total population data.")

    df = pd.read_excel(file_path, skiprows=3, sheet_name="Population")
    df["county_id"] = df["Jurisdiction"].map(cfg["county_map"])
    df = df.loc[df["county_id"].notna()].copy()

    year_choices = {}
    for column in df.columns:
        column_text = str(column)
        match = re.match(r"^(\d{4})\b", column_text.strip())
        if not match:
            continue
        year = match.group(1)
        current = year_choices.get(year)
        if current is None or "Census Count" in column_text:
            year_choices[year] = column

    year_cols = sorted(year_choices)
    ofm = df[["county_id"] + [year_choices[year] for year in year_cols]].copy()
    ofm = ofm.rename(columns={year_choices[year]: year for year in year_cols})
    ofm = ofm.melt(id_vars="county_id", var_name="year", value_name=ofm_type)
    ofm["year"] = ofm["year"].astype(int)
    ofm[ofm_type] = pd.to_numeric(ofm[ofm_type], errors="coerce")
    return ofm.dropna(subset=[ofm_type])


def build_region(county_df):
    region = (
        county_df.groupby("year", as_index=False)
        .agg(total_pop=("total_pop", "sum"), county_count=("county_id", "nunique"))
        .query("county_count == @N_COUNTIES")
        .drop(columns="county_count")
    )
    region["geography"] = "Region"
    return region


def build_trend_windows(max_year):
    """Decade windows (1960s, 1970s, ...) plus rolling last-N-year windows, all fit
    through max_year and extrapolated out to 2060."""
    windows = [(f"{decade_start}s", decade_start, min(decade_start + 9, max_year)) for decade_start in range(1960, 2030, 10)]
    windows += [(f"Last {n} Years", max_year - n + 1, max_year) for n in (10, 20, 30, 45)]
    return windows


def build_trends(history, value_col):
    max_year = int(history["year"].max())
    windows = build_trend_windows(max_year)
    rows = []
    for geography, geography_df in history.dropna(subset=[value_col]).groupby("geography"):
        for label, start_year, end_year in windows:
            fit_df = geography_df.query("@start_year <= year <= @end_year")
            if len(fit_df) < 2:
                continue

            slope = fit_df["year"].cov(fit_df[value_col]) / fit_df["year"].var()
            intercept = fit_df[value_col].mean() - slope * fit_df["year"].mean()
            trend_years = pd.DataFrame({"year": range(start_year, 2061)})
            trend_years[value_col] = slope * trend_years["year"] + intercept
            trend_years["geography"] = geography
            trend_years["trend"] = label
            rows.append(trend_years)
    return pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True)


def clean_luvit_pop(cfg, file_path):
    """Total population rows from the LUVit forecast, in whole persons."""
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    df = df.loc[df["Detailed Measure"] == "Total Population"].copy()
    df["county_id"] = df["Region"].map(cfg["county_map"])
    df = df.loc[df["county_id"].notna()].copy()
    year_cols = [c for c in df.columns if str(c)[:4].isdigit()]
    long = df.melt(id_vars="county_id", value_vars=year_cols, var_name="year", value_name="total_pop")
    long["year"] = long["year"].astype(int)
    long["total_pop"] = (long["total_pop"].astype(float) * 1000).round(0).astype(int)
    return long


def clean_remi_v33(cfg, file_path):
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    df = df.loc[df["name"] == "REMI_v3.3", ["county_id", "year", "total_pop"]].copy()
    return df.loc[df["year"] > cfg["remi_base_year"]]


def build_forecast_series(county_forecast_df, series_name):
    """County + region rows for one forecast source, labeled for the toggle/legend."""
    county_forecast_df = county_forecast_df.loc[county_forecast_df["county_id"].isin(COUNTY_IDS)].copy()
    region = build_region(county_forecast_df)
    county_forecast_df["geography"] = county_forecast_df["county_id"].map(ID_TO_COUNTY)
    combined = pd.concat([county_forecast_df.drop(columns="county_id"), region], ignore_index=True)
    combined["series"] = series_name
    return combined


ofm = clean_ofm(cfg, os.path.join(cfg["data_dir"], cfg["ofm_population_file"]))
county_df = ofm[ofm["county_id"].isin(COUNTY_IDS)].copy()
county_df["geography"] = county_df["county_id"].map(ID_TO_COUNTY)
county_df = county_df[["year", "geography", "county_id", "total_pop"]]

history = pd.concat(
    [county_df.drop(columns="county_id"), build_region(county_df)],
    ignore_index=True,
).sort_values(["geography", "year"])
history["annual_pct_change"] = history.groupby("geography")["total_pop"].pct_change() * 100
history["series"] = "OFM population"

# Forecasts (toggleable; OFM history above is always shown).
luvit = clean_luvit_pop(cfg, os.path.join(cfg["data_dir"], cfg["luvit_forecast_file"]))
remi_v33 = clean_remi_v33(cfg, os.path.join(cfg["data_dir"], cfg["remi_output_file"]))

forecasts = pd.concat(
    [build_forecast_series(luvit, "LUVit"), build_forecast_series(remi_v33, "REMI v3.3")],
    ignore_index=True,
).sort_values(["series", "geography", "year"])
forecasts["annual_pct_change"] = forecasts.groupby(["series", "geography"])["total_pop"].pct_change() * 100

plot_data = pd.concat([history, forecasts], ignore_index=True)

trends = build_trends(history, "total_pop")
change_trends = build_trends(history, "annual_pct_change")

ojs_define(history=plot_data, trends=trends, change_trends=change_trends)
```

# Dashboard

## {.sidebar width="300px"}

```{ojs}
viewof geography = Inputs.radio(geographies, {label: "Geography", value: "Region"})
```

```{ojs}
viewof metric = Inputs.select(metrics, {label: "Metric", value: "total_pop", format: d => metricLabels[d]})
```

```{ojs}
viewof selectedTrendlines = Inputs.checkbox(trendlineOptions, {label: "Trendlines", value: ["2020s"]})
```

```{ojs}
viewof selectedForecasts = Inputs.checkbox(["LUVit", "REMI v3.3"], {label: "Forecasts", value: ["LUVit", "REMI v3.3"]})
```

```{ojs}
viewof showPoints = Inputs.toggle({label: "Show annual points", value: true})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
seriesData = transpose(history)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
trendData = transpose(trends)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
changeTrendData = transpose(change_trends)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
countyOrder = ["King County", "Kitsap County", "Pierce County", "Snohomish County"]
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
geographies = ["Region"].concat(countyOrder)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
trendlineOptions = Array.from(new Set(trendData.map(d => d.trend))).sort()
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
metrics = ["total_pop", "annual_pct_change"]
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
metricLabels = {
  return {
    total_pop: "Population",
    annual_pct_change: "% Annual Change"
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
selectedSeries = seriesData.filter(d =>
  d.geography === geography &&
  d[metric] != null &&
  (d.series === "OFM population" || selectedForecasts.includes(d.series))
)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
selectedTrends = (metric === "total_pop" ? trendData : changeTrendData).filter(d =>
  d.geography === geography && selectedTrendlines.includes(d.trend) && d[metric] != null
)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
yFormat = metric === "annual_pct_change" ? d => `${d.toFixed(1)}%` : undefined
```

## Column

```{ojs}
//| title: OFM population history, forecasts, and decade trendlines
Plot.plot({
  marginLeft: 85,
  marginRight: 25,
  x: {label: "Year", domain: [1960, 2060], tickFormat: "d"},
  y: {label: metricLabels[metric], grid: true, nice: true, tickFormat: yFormat},
  color: {legend: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: "#ddd"}),
    Plot.line(selectedSeries, {
      x: "year",
      y: metric,
      stroke: "series",
      strokeWidth: 2.6
    }),
    showPoints ? Plot.dot(selectedSeries, {
      x: "year",
      y: metric,
      stroke: "series",
      fill: "white",
      r: 2.4
    }) : null,
    Plot.line(selectedTrends, {
      x: "year",
      y: metric,
      stroke: "trend",
      strokeDasharray: "6,4",
      strokeWidth: 1.6
    }),
    Plot.tip(
      selectedSeries,
      Plot.pointer({x: "year", y: metric, channels: {value: metric}})
    )
  ]
})
```
